```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Libertarian socialists believe in delegation, not representation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Individuals entrusted with reflecting DSA’s values within bourgeois democratic systems should be bound in discipline to the democratic will of DSA’s members, rather than their own independent desires.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s endorsed elected officials should be committed to using their positions to build DSA and other structures of independent working-class power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s endorsed elected officials must be deeply embedded in DSA’s organizing, in constant and transparent coordination with DSA’s elected leadership, and held subject to the oversight of DSA’s general membership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s endorsed elected officials must vote in accordance with DSA’s platform and do not capitulate to the pressures of empire.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If DSA’s relationship with an elected official cannot meet specified standards, or if undue influence by an elected official associated with DSA threatens to undermine the will of DSA’s membership, those ties should be severed by the chapter membership, and by the national organization if the chapter is unable or unwilling to do so.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists in office must act as a fifth column within the capitalist state, not as instruments of the state against revolutionary socialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
